description: IBCS small multiples (CO 5.1, CH 4.1): one column chart per structure element, all on the identical value scale (shared y), AC solid / FC hatched with the reference scenario overlapped behind. Data-driven panel dimensions, period-qualified end labels, and selective scenario-labelled totals.

fields.Panel: text, structure element per panel (≤ 25 panels; aggregate the rest into an 'Others' panel in DAX)
fields.Period: text, category label; supply rows in period order within each panel; month1 uses the first letter of this label
fields.PxPerUnit: optional measure, same positive value on every populated row: px per display unit for the scale group; overrides pxPerUnit and sizes panel plots automatically
fields.ShowTotal: optional measure/column 1/0 (or true/false) per row: show this panel's total when panelTotals = 'field'

ibcs.notes: Never set resolve.scale.y to independent. All panels in this facet have the same plot height and shared y domain, using the maximum across the displayed panels. For an element that needs a different plot height at the same scale (CO 5.1), use a separate Deneb visual with the same pxPerUnit; its height now derives from its own data. panelHeight / panelWidth = 0 select automatic sizing; no spec.height edit is needed. Blank Panel/Period rows and rows with AC, FC, PY and PL all null are dropped, even when constant PxPerUnit/ShowTotal measures are present; reference-only and zero-valued rows remain. Facets fill left to right, then the next row, in first-appearance Panel order. Periods retain source order. periodLabel = auto keeps full labels when they fit and uses initials for crowded month panels; month1 always uses initials; none hides labels. Selective totals: panelTotals = none (default), all, field (any ShowTotal = 1 in that panel), or a comma-separated list of panel names. A selected panel shows only its AC, FC or AC&FC total; its last-value label is suppressed. Other panels show a period-qualified last value. Reference-only panel totals are N/A. Totals are labels, never extra columns; a year total next to months needs its own scale. Internal width/height expression params use the first transformed dataset (data_0 in the bundled Vega-Lite version); spec.name must remain an empty string so these built-in size params control the facet plots.

tiers.range: 0 … max(AC/FC, selected reference) across all displayed panels; include negative minima when present

layout.rule: With pxPerUnit > 0 (or positive PxPerUnit field), auto panel plot height = (hi - lo) × effective pxPerUnit + ibcsLabelPx, where lo = min(0, data minimum), hi = max(0, data maximum) across all displayed panels after unitDivisor. For nonnegative data this is max data value × pxPerUnit + label room. panelHeight > 0 is a minimum plot height in this mode: extra height extends the domain at the same px per unit; a smaller height cannot compress the data. With pxPerUnit off, panelHeight > 0 is the fixed plot height, otherwise 70 px. panelWidth > 0 is the fixed plot width; otherwise max(150, distinct Period count × ibcsCategoryStep[periodType] × stepScale).
layout.container: scale_layout sizes one panel plot from tiers.panel = [lo, hi] and ibcsLabelPx, not the whole facet container. For N populated panels and columns = 3, R = ceil(N / 3) rows. Every panel draws its own category axis (resolve.axis.x independent, so a wrapped grid never shows an empty axis). Container height >= R × (panel plot height + panelHeaderPx (16; 32 with panelTotals) + panelCategoryLabelsPx (18; 0 for periodLabel none)) + (R - 1) × 10 + 10 px outer padding; allow more for changed fonts. scale_layout.py prints it (member panels, columns, panelTotals, periodLabel). Container width >= min(N, 3) × panel plot width + (min(N, 3) - 1) × 18 + 10. Facet plots do not shrink to fit a smaller container.

params.name: refScenario
params.description: reference scenario drawn behind the columns: PY (solid light) or PL / BU (outlined)

params.name: decimals
params.description: decimals of every value label (display units); also the precision of the rounded-zero rule

params.name: unitDivisor
params.description: divides every value before drawing and labelling: 1 = the measures are already scaled (preferred, e.g. a scaled measure or a Scale picker), 1000 = thousands, 1000000 = millions. The unit belongs in the title (UN 2.2), never as K/M suffixes

params.name: yMax
params.description: 0 = from the data; a number fixes the panels' domain (shared DOMAIN: the same px per unit only at the same panel height). To share the page's scale group use pxPerUnit

params.name: panelHeight
params.description: Panel plot height in px; 0 = auto (70 with pxPerUnit off; data range × effective pxPerUnit + ibcsLabelPx with it on). With pxPerUnit on, a positive value is a minimum height; data and label room win if taller.

params.name: panelWidth
params.description: Panel plot width in px; 0 = auto: max(150, distinct Period count × ibcsCategoryStep[periodType] × stepScale). A positive value fixes the width.

params.name: periodLabel
params.description: auto = full labels, or first letters for crowded month panels; month1 = first letter of each Period (J F M … for month names); none = hide period labels.

params.name: width
params.description: Internal built-in plot width; spec.name must remain empty. Derived from the filtered, transformed data, not the container.

params.name: height
params.description: Internal built-in plot height; spec.name must remain empty. Derived from the filtered, transformed data, not the container.

params.name: pxPerUnit
params.description: Pixels per display unit after unitDivisor; 0 = off. A positive PxPerUnit field overrides this knob. Automatically sizes every panel plot from the displayed data range plus ibcsLabelPx, preserving the exact scale; panelHeight can add room without changing it. See usermeta.ibcs.layout for container sizing.

params.name: ibcsLabelPx
params.description: label room in px above the tallest column (pxPerUnit > 0 only)

params.name: showGrid
params.description: light gridlines are allowed in small multiples (SI 3.1)

params.name: panelTotals
params.description: none | all | field | comma-separated panel names: selected panels show only their scenario-labelled total (AC, FC or AC&FC); other panels retain a period-qualified last-value label.

params.name: stepScale
params.description: screen scaling of the token category step; keep it identical on every page

params.name: periodType
params.description: year | quarter | month | week | day: column width per period type (UN 3.3)

transform.filter: isValid(datum['AC']) || isValid(datum['FC']) || isValid(datum['PY']) || isValid(datum['PL']) || isValid(datum['BU']) || isValid(datum[refScenario])

transform.calculate: panelTotals == 'all' || (panelTotals == 'field' && datum._pShow == 1) || (panelTotals != 'none' && panelTotals != 'all' && panelTotals != 'field' && indexof(split(replace(panelTotals, / *, */g, ','), ','), datum['Panel']) >= 0)
datum._ppu > 0 ? max(panelHeight, (datum._hi - datum._lo) * datum._ppu + ibcsLabelPx) : (panelHeight > 0 ? panelHeight : 70)
panelWidth > 0 ? panelWidth : max(150, datum._periodCount * ibcsCategoryStep[periodType] * stepScale)
datum._ppu > 0 ? datum._lo + datum._plotHeight / datum._ppu : (yMax > 0 ? yMax : max(1, datum._hi * 1.18))
isValid(datum._v) ? format(abs(datum._v) * pow(10, decimals) < 0.5 ? 0 : datum._v, replace(ibcsFmtAbs, /[.][0-9]+/, '.' + decimals)) : ''

axis.labelExpr: periodLabel == 'month1' || (periodLabel == 'auto' && periodType == 'month' && bandwidth('x') / ibcsBarRatio < (ibcsFontSize - 2) * 2.1) ? substring(datum.label, 0, 1) : datum.label

layer.description: selection (cross-filtering): assisting-area band behind every mark of the selected category; no mark is dimmed (a dimmed AC reads like PY)
category axis (base line), drawn before the columns so every mark is in front of it

Period-qualified last-value label only when this panel is not showing its total; never an unexplained bare number. It sits above the taller of the last two columns, since the right-aligned text extends over the previous column.

transform.calculate: max(datum._v, isValid(datum._r) ? datum._r : 0, isValid(datum._pv) ? datum._pv : 0, isValid(datum._pr) ? datum._pr : 0)

layer.description: selective panel totals (CO 5.1): the panel's sum of AC&FC, right-aligned on the panel's header line, only for the panels chosen by panelTotals; hatched-period sums are labelled AC&FC (invisible placeholder in the other panels keeps every panel's plot at the same height)

value.expr: datum._showT ? ((datum._pFC > 0 ? (datum._pAC > 0 ? 'AC&FC ' : 'FC ') : 'AC ') + (datum._pValid > 0 ? format(abs(datum._pSum) * pow(10, decimals) < 0.5 ? 0 : datum._pSum, replace(ibcsFmtAbs, /[.][0-9]+/, '.' + decimals)) : 'N/A')) : 'AC 0'
